name: trillet
description: Connect Trillet voice AI so Grok Bot / Cursor can claim numbers, spin up agents, and place outbound calls from chat.

TRILLET_API_KEY.title: API key
TRILLET_API_KEY.description: Secret Trillet API key from Trillet Studio: Settings → Workspace → Developer → API Keys (https://app.trillet.ai). Cursor stores the value. Do not commit it.

TRILLET_WORKSPACE_ID.title: Workspace ID
TRILLET_WORKSPACE_ID.description: Default workspace id: 24-character hex from the Trillet Studio URL or workspace settings.
